title: Multi-Strategy CSI 500 Enhancement with Deep Learning Factor Integration
tldr: Multi-strategy approach combining deep learning and traditional factors significantly improves CSI 500 index enhancement, with annualized return up ~10% over traditional multi-factor methods.
abstract: Traditional multi-factor index enhancement suffers from factor instability across time and cross-section. This report proposes a multi-strategy framework that constructs sub-strategies using multi-granularity deep learning factors and small-cap high-growth factors across different stock universes, then composites them via terminal optimization. The multi-strategy composite significantly outperforms traditional multi-factor approaches for CSI 500 enhancement, with annualized excess return improving approximately 10% and information ratio notably enhanced. Under 80% constituent stock constraint, the IR-optimized multi-strategy achieves 18.32% annualized return with IR of 2.273. Challenges include sub-strategy weight allocation, limited risk factor exposure control, and high turnover (~20x vs 8x for traditional methods).
strategy: The strategy builds a multi-strategy CSI 500 index enhancement by: (1) constructing sub-strategies using multi-granularity deep learning factors and small-cap high-growth composite factors across CSI 500 constituent and whole-market universes; (2) compositing sub-strategies through a two-step process: first selecting best-performing sub-strategies within the same domain and factor type via return T-value comparison, then weighted compositing across different factor types when performance differences are small; (3) optimizing the final 500-constituent and whole-market composite portfolios via optimizer targeting either return or information ratio objectives with constituent stock weight constraints. Key innovation is decoupling factor selection from portfolio construction, maximizing each factor's stock-picking effect within its suitable domain before terminal optimization. [source: "通过构建不同因子类型子策略，再在终端进行组合优化可以显著提升指数增强效果"]
method: The methodology involves: (1) Building four base sub-strategy categories: CSI 500 multi-granularity, CSI 500 high-growth (excluding market cap factor), whole-market multi-granularity, and whole-market small-cap high-growth. Each varies by aggressiveness parameter (max stock weight 1%, 2%, 5%) and reverse elimination weight (1%, 2%, 5%, 10%) where each factor's negative signal trims the other's stock pool. (2) Multi-granularity strategies include daily (6% turnover constraint) and weekly (30% turnover constraint) rebalancing; high-growth strategies are monthly with no turnover constraint. (3) Two-step compositing: first intra-domain/factor selection via T-value ranking, then cross-domain weighted compositing. (4) Final optimization uses either historical return or information ratio (combining excess return and Barra factor exposure) as objective, with constituent stock proportion constraints (20%, 50%, 80%). [source: "基础子策略以 500 成分内、全市场两个选股域，以及小市值高增长、多粒度因子两类复合因子，构建四个大类子策略"]
experiment: Backtested from January 2020 to March 2026. First evaluated individual factor performance (8 small-cap high-growth factors and multi-granularity deep learning factor) across whole-market and CSI 500 constituent universes using IC, IC-IR, long/short returns and win rates. Compared multi-granularity daily/weekly and small-cap high-growth strategies in both whole-market and CSI 500 constituent settings. Evaluated composite factor strategies versus individual factor strategies in both universes. Constructed multi-strategy composites under different constituent stock constraints (20%, 50%, 80%) with two optimization objectives (return-optimal and IR-optimal). Also tested hedged absolute return portfolios using CSI 500 stock index futures. [source: "多策略复合（信息比最优）|18.32%|2.273|9.04%|2.027"]
result: Under 80% constituent constraint, the multi-strategy composite (IR-optimal) achieves 18.32% annualized excess return, IR of 2.273, max drawdown 9.04%, and return/drawdown ratio of 2.027, significantly outperforming individual factor strategies (high-growth: 8.20% return/1.843 IR; small-cap high-growth: 7.50% return/1.689 IR). The return-optimal multi-strategy achieves 17.15% return with 2.138 IR. With 20% constituent constraint, return-optimal reaches 26.03% annualized return. Hedging with CSI 500 futures yields ~10% absolute return with Sharpe ~1. However, turnover reaches ~20x versus 8x for traditional multi-factor.
